description: This is a test file for the PendingMessagesComponent, containing unit tests that check rendering and clearing of scheduled messages in a UI component.

classes.name: PendingMessagesComponent
classes.description: A UI component that manages and renders pending messages with different modes such as 'steer' and 'followUp'.

methods.name: setMessages
methods.description: Sets the current list of messages to be displayed.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the list of messages into a displayable format, based on a provided parameter (e.g., width).

methods.name: clearMessages
methods.description: Clears all current messages from the component.
